description: Hot comments on one Bilibili video from Bilibili's public comment endpoint: comment id, author name, text, like count, reply count and time (up to 20, most-liked first). Needs the video's numeric aid (the number in the av<aid> URL); the tool does not convert BV ids. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

aid.description: Bilibili video aid (digits, e.g. 170001 from av170001)
